## reference · Google Business Profile local SEO ranking factors 2026

*   Google's local search algorithm uses three core components: Proximity, Relevance, and Prominence.
*   **Proximity:** Physical distance between user/search location and business. Ensure accurate Name, Address, Phone Number (NAP) on Google Business Profile (GBP) and other listings.
*   **Relevance:** How well a business listing matches the search query. Influenced by business categories, website keywords, user-generated content (reviews).
*   **Prominence:** How well-known and trusted a business is. Influenced by backlinks, social media mentions, online reviews, and web mentions.

**Local Pack / Maps Ranking Factors (Grouped, 2026 Survey):**
1.  Google Business Profile (32%)
2.  Reviews (20%)
3.  On-page (15%)
4.  Behavioral (9%)
5.  Links (8%)
6.  Citations (6%)
7.  Personalization (6%)
8.  Social (4%)

**Local Organic Ranking Factors (Grouped, 2026 Survey):**
1.  On-page (33%)
2.  Links (24%)
3.  Behavioral (10%)
4.  Personalization (8%)
5.  Google Business Profile (7%)
6.  Citations (7%)
7.  Reviews (6%)
8.  Social (5%)

**Changes from 2023 to 2026 Survey:**
*   On-page factors decreased slightly for both local pack (from 19% to 15%) and local organic (from 36% to 33%).
*   Reviews increased in importance for local pack rankings (from 16% to 20%).
*   Link signals continued to drop, especially for local pack rankings.
*   Citations remained steady but gained importance in AI visibility factors.
*   Social signals were added back as a group in 2026, potentially impacting other factors' percentages.

**Top 15 Individual Local Pack / Maps Ranking Factors (2026 Survey):**
1.  Primary GBP category
2.  Proximity of address to the point of search
3.  Keywords in GBP business title
4.  Physical address in the city of search
5.  Business is open at the time of search
6.  High Google star ratings
7.  Address shows on GBP
8.  Additional GBP categories
9.  Number of native Google reviews with text
10. Map pin properly placed
11. Recency of reviews
12. Proximity of address to center
13. Clickthrough rate from local search results
14. Steady growth of reviews over time
15. HTML NAP matching GBP NAP

**Top 15 Individual Local Organic Ranking Factors (2026 Survey):**
1.  Dedicated page for each service
2.  Geographic keyword relevance of content
3.  Quality / authority of inbound links to domain
4.  Keywords in GBP landing page title tag
5.  Number of inbound links to domain from industry-relevant domains
6.  Internal linking across website
7.  Relevant product / service keywords across website
8.  Keywords in GBP landing page headings
9.  Website focuses on specific niche
10. Keywords in anchor text of inbound links to domain
11. Keywords in title tags across website
12. Diversity of inbound links to domain
13. Quantity of inbound links to domain from locally-relevant domains
14. Volume of quality content across website
15. Keywords in headings across website

**AI Search Visibility Factors (Grouped, 2026 Survey):**
1.  On-page (24%)
2.  Reviews (16%)
3.  Citations (13%)
4.  Links (13%)
5.  GBP (12%)
6.  Personalization (9%)
7.  Social (9%)

**Top 15 Individual AI Search Visibility Factors (2026 Survey):**

2.  Dedicated page for each service
3.  Prominence on key industry relevant domains
4.  Quality / authority of unstructured citations
5.  Authority of third-party sites where reviews are present
6.  Geographic keyword relevance of content
7.  Number of unstructured citations
8.  High Google star ratings
9.  Website focuses on specific niche
10. Scannable content structure across website
11. Diversity of third-party sites where reviews are present
12. Number of unlinked brand mentions
13. Number of third-party unstructured reviews
14. Volume of quality content across website
15. Number of citations from industry-relevant domains

**Average Importance of Grouped Local SEO Ranking Factors (including AI):**
